patches.name: APK Junk Cleaner
patches.description: Strips non-functional build metadata, compiler properties, Kotlin coroutines debug tables, and duplicate license texts from META-INF and APK root.

patches.name: Ad Dispatch Governor
patches.description: Neutralizes ad loaders, unlocks ad-free status, and strips mediation components & startup providers.

patches.name: Always Show Publish Date
patches.description: Forces video publish/upload date to remain visible in video author information across all feed types.

patches.name: Anti-Tamper Bypass
patches.description: Bypasses Xposed and hook detection, neutralizes VPN and ADB security checks, bypasses root and emulator detection, and hardens WebView JavaScript bridges.

patches.name: Asset Debloat
patches.description: Strips embedded ad DEX, tracking scripts, web templates, and ad drawables to reduce APK size.

patches.name: Auto-Pause First Video
patches.description: Automatically pauses the first video when opening TikTok, allowing the application to finish background initialization and preventing playback lag.

patches.name: Background Optimizer
patches.description: Neutralizes KeepAliveForegroundService, background BLE observation, companion device manager, and MIUI Nearby discovery to eliminate persistent notifications, wakelocks, and background battery drain.

patches.name: Background Sync & JobScheduler Purge
patches.description: Strips RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED and disables boot, package-replacement, and periodic background sync receivers and services in AndroidManifest.xml to eliminate background wakeups and conserve battery.

options.title: Strip RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED Permission
options.description: Remove android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED from AndroidManifest.xml.

options.title: Disable Boot & Package Receivers
options.description: Set android:enabled='false' on broadcast receivers listening for BOOT_COMPLETED, LOCKED_BOOT_COMPLETED, or MY_PACKAGE_REPLACED.

options.title: Disable WorkManager & Job Schedulers
options.description: Disable AndroidX WorkManager, Google DataTransport, and ProfileInstaller background services and receivers.

options.title: Strip WAKE_LOCK Permission
options.description: Remove android.permission.WAKE_LOCK. Default is false to prevent interrupting background audio playback or active downloads.

patches.name: Background Sync Optimizer
patches.description: Neutralizes background WorkManager constraint tasks and diagnostic wakelocks.

patches.name: Battery & Background Sync Optimizer
patches.description: Disables background WorkManager alarms, periodic job schedulers, Google Play Billing IPC (~89 MB RAM), and removes largeHeap to force aggressive Garbage Collection.

patches.name: Block Brave Telemetry
patches.description: Blocks P3A product analytics, Brave Stats usage pings, crash dump uploads, WDP, Chromium UMA metrics, and Variations seed fetching.

patches.name: Block Telemetry
patches.description: Disables background metrics dispatch, event logging, daily pings, Google Primes profiling, crash reporting, AppDoctor diagnostics, and Tenor share tracking.

patches.name: Block Telemetry & Trackers
patches.description: Neutralizes Sentry crash reporting, Adjust attribution, Facebook AppEvents, Branch referral tracking, and WearOS background sync.

patches.name: Block Telemetry & Trackers
patches.description: Neutralizes Firebase Analytics, Google Measurement, TikTok Business SDK, and crashlytics tracking.

patches.name: Block Telemetry & Trackers
patches.description: Neutralizes Firebase Analytics, Xiaomi OneTrack, AutoReportHelper, and GlobalReport telemetry and event dispatching.

patches.name: Brave In-Product & Commercial Notification Optimizer
patches.description: Eliminates background wakeups and notifications from Chromium tips scheduler (Job ID 105), Brave Rewards onboarding promo, and retention marketing campaigns.

patches.name: Brave Origin
patches.description: Unlocks Brave Origin and enables local feature toggle controls.

patches.name: Brave Startup Performance Optimization
patches.description: Optimizes startup time and eliminates background CPU/disk overhead by disabling unused OEM carrier partner customizations.

patches.name: Bypass Mandatory Login
patches.description: Neutralizes mandatory login walls, dynamic regional forced login gates, and guest browsing restrictions.

patches.name: Bypass Screen Capture Detection
patches.description: Clears FLAG_SECURE on protected windows, restores Circle to Search / screen translate and recent apps snapshots, and neutralizes screenshot detection listeners and feedback prompts.

patches.name: Clean New Tab Page
patches.description: Removes sponsored wallpaper images, Brave News/Today feeds, marketing widgets, and promo cards from the New Tab Page.

options.title: Hide Top Sites & Shortcuts
options.description: Removes top sites shortcuts and most visited tiles from the New Tab Page for a completely blank home screen.

patches.name: Clean Share Panel
patches.description: Removes clutter from the share panel and direct message dialog, including suggested quick emojis and the 'Send to new group' button.

options.title: Hide Quick Emojis
options.description: Removes the horizontal row of suggested quick emojis from the direct share panel.

options.title: Hide 'Send to New Group'
options.description: Removes the 'Send to new group' button and hint from the direct share panel.

patches.name: Clean Share URL
patches.description: Strips tracking parameters (utm_*, fbclid, gclid, igshid, si, msclkid) when sharing or copying links.

patches.name: Clean Share URL
patches.description: Strips tracking parameters, user IDs, device fingerprints, and marketing tokens from shared TikTok links.

patches.name: Client-Side AI & Behavioral Profiling Governor
patches.description: Neutralizes on-device machine learning inference (Pitaya), Tako AI chatbot entry points and icons, and AI smart search suggestion clutter.

patches.name: Clone Gboard
patches.description: Changes the package name by appending a dot and custom suffix (defaults to 'clone') to allow installing Gboard alongside the original application.

options.title: Package name suffix
options.description: Suffix appended after the original package name and a dot (e.g. 'clone' -> 'com.google.android.inputmethod.latin.clone').

patches.name: Comment Customizer

options.title: Comment Sort Controls
options.description: Unlocks TikTok's native comment sorting menu (Hot, Newest, Creator only, With media) across all posts.

options.title: Copy Comments Without Username
options.description: Copies only the comment text without prepending the author username.

options.title: Disable Suggested Emojis
options.description: Removes the horizontal bar of suggested quick emojis displayed above the comment input box.

options.title: Hide Comment Quick Actions
options.description: Hides the quick action buttons (photo, emoji, and mention) inside the comment input bar.

options.title: Hide Comment Surveys & Feedback Cards

options.title: Hide Comment Story Rings
options.description: Removes profile photo story rings from avatars in the comment section.

options.title: Enable Voice Comments
options.description: Forces the native voice comment recording button in comment input bars, bypassing regional rollout restrictions and remote server blocks.

options.title: Auto-Translate Comments
options.description: Automatically translates comments into your preferred language using TikTok's native translation engine.

patches.name: Core Asset De-bloat
patches.description: Strips embedded Microblink/FinTech card scanner models, Pitaya AI & ByteNN LLM engines, C2PA origin verification, DLNA cast scanners, and redundant non-Latin fonts to save APK space.

patches.name: Custom Offline Videos Limit

options.title: Custom Offline Videos Limit
options.description: Maximum number of offline videos that can be cached for offline playback (default: 1000).

options.title: Hide QR Code

options.title: Hide 'Copy Link'

options.title: Hide System Share ('More')

options.title: Hide Friends / Direct Messages Row

options.title: Hide 'Promote' Action

options.title: Hide 'Duet' Action

options.title: Hide 'Stitch' Action
options.description: Hides the Stitch action from the bottom utilities row.

options.title: Hide 'Picture-in-Picture' (PiP)

options.title: Hide 'Clear Display'
options.description: Hides the Clear display mode action from the bottom utilities row.

options.title: Hide 'Background Audio'
options.description: Hides the background audio playback action from the bottom utilities row.

options.title: Hide Live Wallpaper & GIF
options.description: Hides Live wallpaper and GIF creation actions from the bottom utilities row.

options.title: Hide 'Not Interested'
options.description: Hides the 'Not interested' action from the bottom utilities row.

options.title: Hide 'Report'
options.description: Hides the Report action from the bottom utilities row.

patches.name: DPI Resource Slimmer
patches.description: Strips unselected screen density resource directories from res/ (e.g. drawable-mdpi, drawable-hdpi, mipmap-xhdpi). Density-independent resources (nodpi, anydpi) and orphan resources are safely preserved in-situ.

options.title: DPI densities to keep
options.description: Comma-separated screen densities to preserve (e.g. 'xxhdpi', 'xhdpi, xxhdpi', 'xxxhdpi'). Density-independent resources (nodpi, anydpi) and unquantified base directories are always preserved.

options.title: Remove smartwatch (Wear OS) resources
options.description: Removes graphic and non-values layout resources qualified for Wear OS smartwatches (e.g. watch qualifiers).

options.title: Remove Android TV resources
options.description: Removes graphic and non-values layout resources qualified for Android TV / Leanback (e.g. television qualifiers).

options.title: Remove automotive, dock, and VR resources
options.description: Removes graphic and non-values layout resources qualified for car head units, desk docks, appliances, or VR headsets.

patches.name: Device Privacy Guard
patches.description: Neutralizes invasive runtime permissions (contacts sync, location tracking, nearby devices), advertising ID profiling, background clipboard snooping routines, and motion sensor profiling to protect user data.

patches.name: Device Privacy Guard
patches.description: Blinds hardware device IDs, anonymizes device identifiers, neutralizes environment info leakage, and bypasses location checks for Bluetooth scanning.

patches.name: Direct Message Declutter
patches.description: Removes visual clutter in direct messages and chat list, including the call button, reaction tray, message forward button, camera icons, input action buttons, try effect button, and sticker reply suggestions.

options.title: Hide Chat List Camera Button
options.description: Removes the camera icon next to chats in the direct messages conversation list.

options.title: Hide Header Call Button
options.description: Removes the phone receiver (voice/video call) button from the direct message chat header.

options.title: Hide Message Forward Button
options.description: Removes the quick forward/share arrow button displayed next to messages and shared videos.

options.title: Hide Reaction and Streak Bar
options.description: Removes the reaction bar and streak mascot banner displayed above the text input bar.

options.title: Hide Input Bar Camera Button
options.description: Removes the camera button located to the left of the direct message text input field.

options.title: Hide Gallery Button
options.description: Removes the photo gallery button located inside the right side of the text input field.

options.title: Hide Emoji/Stickers Button
options.description: Removes the stickers and emoji button located inside the right side of the text input field.

options.title: Hide Voice Recording Button
options.description: Removes the audio recording/microphone button located inside the right side of the text input field.

options.title: Hide Try Effect Button
options.description: Removes the 'Try effect' camera button shown on shared videos that use an effect in direct messages.

options.title: Hide Sticker Reply Suggestions
options.description: Removes the automatic 'Tap a sticker to reply' suggestion panel above the input bar. The manual sticker reply button keeps working.

patches.name: Disable Background Sync
patches.description: Neutralizes AndroidX WorkManager schedulers, MDD (Mobile Data Download) periodic sync, and Superpacks eager asset synchronization (opt-in to preserve initial dictionary downloads).

patches.name: Disable Background Sync & Periodic Sync
patches.description: Eliminates background wakeups, radio modem activity, and battery drain by forcing GooglePlayServicesChecker.shouldDisableBackgroundSync() -> true and neutralizing wakeup tasks.

patches.name: Disable Battery Status API & OS Listener
patches.description: Neutralizes the Battery Status API (navigator.getBattery) to prevent cross-site device fingerprinting and drops OS battery change broadcasts.

patches.name: Disable Cloud Backup
patches.description: Disables Android backup for Gboard (allowBackup=false and backup agent removed) so keyboard settings, learned words, and personal dictionary data are never uploaded to Google Drive backups or copied by device-to-device transfer.

patches.name: Disable Double Tap to Like
patches.description: Disables the double tap gesture to like videos in the feed, preventing accidental likes while scrolling or pausing. Videos can still be liked using the like button.

patches.name: Disable Feed Long-Press Actions
patches.description: Disables long-press action gestures on feed buttons, including Like to repost, Share to quick DMs, and Comment to quick emojis.

options.title: Disable Long-Press Like (Repost)
options.description: Prevents holding the Like button on feed videos from opening the Repost action panel.

options.title: Disable Long-Press Share (Quick DMs)
options.description: Prevents holding the Share button on feed videos from opening the quick share recent contacts tray.

options.title: Disable Long-Press Comment (Quick Emojis)
options.description: Prevents holding the Comment button on feed videos from opening the quick reaction emojis picker.

patches.name: Disable HDR Video Playback
patches.description: Forces the video playback engine to select standard SDR bitrates (BT.709/sRGB) instead of HDR (HDR10/PQ/HLG), preventing blinding screen brightness spikes and display thermal throttling while preserving smooth playback.

patches.name: Disable Play Services Integration
patches.description: Makes Gboard's Google Play services availability check always report SERVICE_DISABLED, so GMS-backed code paths (Clearcut logging, Phenotype, account sync, Google Help feedback) are skipped at the source instead of being attempted.

patches.name: Disable Post-Download Share Dialog
patches.description: Suppresses the automatic 'Share to' and friend suggestions bottom sheet that pops up after finishing a download.

patches.name: Disable Profile Photo LIVE Status
patches.description: Removes the pulsing LIVE ring and badge from creator avatars in the feed and ensures clicking navigates strictly to the user profile instead of launching the live stream.

patches.name: Disable Promos & Nags
patches.description: Bypasses startup privacy agreements, onboarding guides, region selector prompts, and Bluetooth permission nags, and disables in-app promotional banners, marketing activities, and store review nag dialogs.

patches.name: Disable Push Notifications
patches.description: Neutralizes background push notification tasks and persistent socket wake locks to eliminate background battery drain.

patches.name: Disable Remote Configuration
patches.description: Disables periodic remote experiment flag synchronization and background updates.

patches.name: Disable Search History Recording
patches.description: Prevents search queries and keywords from being recorded in local history, databases, and analytics stores.

patches.name: Disable Search Video Autoplay
patches.description: Disables automatic video playback in search results. Videos only play when tapped to view in detail.

patches.name: Disable Tab Auto-Minimization
patches.description: Prevents Brave from minimizing active tabs to the background and forcing a New Tab Page when returning to the browser after inactivity.

patches.name: Disable Watch History Recording
patches.description: Prevents viewed videos from being recorded in account watch history, playback duration stores, and local history caches.

patches.name: Display Refresh Rate Governor
patches.description: Forces TikTok to run at peak display refresh rate (120Hz/90Hz/60Hz) and neutralizes video playback framerate downclocking routines.

options.title: Target Refresh Rate
options.description: Select target display refresh rate: max (display peak rate), 120 (120 Hz), 90 (90 Hz), or 60 (60 Hz). Clamped automatically to display maximum.

patches.name: Enable Profile Banner
patches.description: Unlocks the custom profile banner (background header cover) feature on user profiles and enables the banner selection and editing tools in Edit Profile.

patches.name: Feed Ad Blocker
patches.description: Removes sponsored advertisements, brand promotions, and promotional audio from the For You, Following, and Search feeds.

patches.name: Feed Bloat & Distraction Blocker
patches.description: Removes non-video clutter and floating ad widgets from the For You, Following, and Friends feeds, including Touchpoint Rewards pendants, floating ad stickers, suggested friend cards, mini-games, CapCut/template creation prompts, memories ('On This Day'), community/topic cards, post-video surveys and evaluation questionnaires, mini-drama paywalls, and in-feed search recommendations/interest cards.

patches.name: Feed Interface Declutter
patches.description: Customizes and cleans feed video overlay elements, including the full screen button, repost pill, video descriptions, profile photo follow badges, story rings, playlist bottom bars, save buttons, and music discs.

options.title: Hide Repost Badge
options.description: Hides the repost and shared-by pill badge ('Shared by' / 'Reposted') above creator details on feed videos.

options.title: Hide Video Descriptions
options.description: Hides video descriptions, captions, and hashtags across feed videos while keeping creator and author title intact.

options.title: Hide Profile Photo Follow Button
options.description: Hides the plus (+) follow badge on creator profile avatars in the feed and disables its touch interaction.

options.title: Disable Story Feed Indicators
options.description: Removes creator profile photo story rings from feed videos, ensuring avatar photos remain clean without blue story rings.

options.title: Hide Playlist Bottom Bar
options.description: Hides the playlist indicator bar displayed above the bottom navigation when a video is part of a playlist.

options.title: Hide Save Button
options.description: Hides the bookmark/favorite save button on the right-side action rail of feed videos.

options.title: Hide Music Cover Disc
options.description: Hides the rotating vinyl music album cover disc at the bottom right corner of feed videos.

options.title: Hide Full Screen Button
options.description: Hides the floating 'Full screen' landscape orientation button overlay on horizontal feed videos.

patches.name: Feed Live Stream Blocker
patches.description: Removes live stream broadcast cards and live recommendations from the For You and Following feeds.

patches.name: Fix Google Login
patches.description: Restores Google account sign-in after patching by forcing fallback to Web-based OAuth when Google Play Services rejects the modified APK signature.

patches.name: Fix Spotify Login
patches.description: Restores the 'Add to Spotify' music button after patching by routing the Spotify app sign-in, which rejects the modified APK signature, through Spotify's Web-based OAuth.

patches.name: Force Auto-Scroll
patches.description: Forces the activation of the native video auto-scroll experiment flag for accounts and regions that lack it due to A/B testing.

patches.name: Friends Feed Strict Mutuals
patches.description: Filters out suggested accounts, recommended videos, and non-mutual profiles (such as 'People you may know') from the Friends feed so it only plays videos from accounts you mutually follow.

patches.name: Gboard Enhancements
patches.description: Master customization suite bundling in-app toggleable features (AMOLED Pure Black theme, zero bottom inset, independent keyboard vibration, force incognito, voice typing in incognito, clipboard retention, top toolbar icons count, cursor trackpad, and smart flags) managed directly from a top-level Morphe Patches category in Gboard Settings.

patches.name: Guest OTA Unlock
patches.description: Bypasses mandatory Xiaomi account login checks for firmware update queries, allowing guest users to check and perform device OTA updates.

patches.name: Hardened Intent Security
patches.description: Enables Gboard internal external intent protection against unauthorized intent hijacking and removes the exported, permissionless web debug bridge content provider.

patches.name: Hide AI-Generated Content
patches.description: Filters and skips videos tagged with native AI-generated metadata, C2PA content credentials, or creator AI disclosure tags across the For You, Following, and Friends feeds.

patches.name: Hide Inbox Promos & Alerts
patches.description: Hides promotional banners, streak mascot cards, contact sync suggestions, friend recommendations, and migration guide tooltips in the inbox and direct messages.

options.title: Hide Top Promotional Banners
options.description: Hides header banners including the streak pet / mascot, event announcements, top notice banners, and phone link prompts.

options.title: Hide Contact & Friend Recommendations
options.description: Hides user recommendation cards (Chat with contacts / Find and chat with them), suggested accounts, and mutual friends modules in the chatlist.

options.title: Hide Navigation Notices & Tooltips
options.description: Hides UI migration tooltips (e.g. New followers has moved), bulletin board guide banners, and Shop migration notices.

patches.name: Hide Inbox Story & Status Tray
patches.description: Hides the horizontal story, notes, and status tray (Skylight) displayed at the top of direct messages and the inbox.

patches.name: Hide Popular Lives In Search
patches.description: Removes the Popular LIVEs recommendation card and live stream broadcasts from the search discovery page.

patches.name: Hide Seen Videos
patches.description: Filters previously watched videos from incoming For You feed batches.

patches.name: Hide Suggested Searches
patches.description: Removes the suggested search keywords section ('You may like' / 'Search suggestions') from the search discovery page.

patches.name: Hide TikTok Shop & Mall
patches.description: Removes product showcase badges, shopping cart tags, and the TikTok Shop / Mall tab from navigation bars and video posts.

options.title: Hide Shop Navigation Tab
options.description: Removes the TikTok Shop / Mall navigation tab and indicator from navigation bars. Disable if you want to keep access to your purchases and orders while still hiding video product tags.

options.title: Hide Video Product Anchors
options.description: Removes shopping cart tags, product showcase badges, and commercial anchors from FYP and Following feed videos.

patches.name: In-App Browser Privacy Guard
patches.description: Redirects external and third-party web links to the default system browser and neutralizes inline JavaScript tracking, DOM monitoring, and AJAX hooking in residual in-app WebViews.

patches.name: Instant Launch & Splash Blocker
patches.description: Eliminates cold startup delays, background resume splash advertisements, real-time splash requests, and TopView ad preloading.

patches.name: Language Pack Purger
patches.description: Strips unselected language string bundles from assets/strings#lang_* to save APK space.

options.title: Languages to keep
options.description: Comma-separated language codes to keep (e.g. 'en, es, pt, fr, de'). English ('en') is always preserved as safe fallback.

patches.name: Live Stream 3D Gift Optimizer
patches.description: Disables Live 3D gift particle effect engine and widget rendering lifecycle to eliminate frame drops during live streams.

patches.name: Live Stream SDK & Minigame De-bloat
patches.description: Strips Live link mic SDK (liblink_mic_sdk.so), Lyrax RTC broadcasting engines (liblyrax.so), and live stream interactive minigames to reduce APK size and memory footprint.

patches.name: Locale PAK Slimmer
patches.description: Strips unselected language resource PAKs from assets/locales/.

options.title: Locales to keep
options.description: Comma-separated locale codes to keep (e.g. 'es, es-419, en-US, pt-BR, fr, de'). English (en-US) is always kept as a safe fallback.

patches.name: Locale Resource Slimmer
patches.description: Strips unselected language translation directories from res/ (e.g. values-*, raw-*, xml-*). Base fallback resources with no language qualifiers are always preserved.

options.title: Locales to keep
options.description: Comma-separated language codes to preserve (e.g. 'en, es, pt, fr, de'). English fallback is always retained.

patches.name: Media Usability & Watermark-Free Downloader
patches.description: Unblocks the download button on creator-restricted videos inside the Share panel, and routes downloads to clean unwatermarked media streams.

patches.name: Model Catalog Unlock
patches.description: Forces DeviceInfoListCache.isShowProduct to return true, bypassing version-gating and distribution restrictions so that all device models are always displayed and discoverable.

patches.name: Multi-Store Debridger
patches.description: Disables orphan billing activities, services, and permissions for alternative OEM stores (Huawei, Xiaomi, Samsung).

patches.name: Native Bloat Slimmer
patches.description: Strips unused native companion binaries (Impress Vision AI, WireGuard VPN, and Android XR) to significantly reduce APK size.

patches.name: Navigation & Header Declutter
patches.description: Removes clutter from the feed navigation and top header bar, including the Nearby feed tab, Community (Explore) tab, top-left LIVE broadcast button, central '+' create content button, in-video bottom search suggestion bar, friend profile photo previews on the bottom Friends tab, and unread notification badges on the bottom Messages (Inbox) tab.

options.title: Hide Nearby Feed Tab
options.description: Removes the Nearby (local city or region) feed tab from the top navigation feed strip.

options.title: Hide Community Tab
options.description: Removes the Community (Explore) tab from the top navigation feed strip and bottom bar.

options.title: Hide Top-Left LIVE Button
options.description: Removes the top-left LIVE broadcast button and tab entry point from the top navigation bar.

options.title: Hide Feed Search Bar
options.description: Removes the search suggestion pill and trending bar ('Search · <keyword>') from the bottom of feed videos.

options.title: Hide Create / Publish Button
options.description: Removes the central '+' create / publish content button from the bottom navigation bar.

options.title: Hide Friends Tab Avatar Preview
options.description: Prevents friend profile pictures from replacing the Friends icon on the bottom navigation bar and keeps the standard icon visible.

options.title: Hide Inbox Notification Badge
options.description: Removes the unread message counter badge and notification red dot from the bottom Messages (Inbox) tab.

patches.name: Network Security & TLS Inspection
patches.description: Disables cleartext traffic, trusts user-installed certificates, and bypasses OkHttp certificate pinning.

patches.name: Network Security Hardening
patches.description: Enforces user trust anchors while preserving HTTP cleartext traffic for driver downloads and LAN printers.

patches.name: Offline Only
patches.description: Completely isolates Gboard from the network by revoking network permissions, neutralizing HTTP clients (Cronet, OkHttp, Superpacks), and spoofing offline status.

patches.name: Offline Only
patches.description: Completely isolates the app from the network by revoking internet permissions and spoofing offline status. Note: do not activate on first launch; pair your earbuds once before enabling.

patches.name: P2P Video Relay & Mesh CDN Blocker
patches.description: Strips background Peer-to-Peer CDN distribution binaries (libavmdlp2pv2.so and libp2plivevdp.so) to prevent battery drain, background data upload, and mesh relay.

patches.name: PNG Asset Optimizer
patches.description: Losslessly recompresses PNG assets with maximum zlib compression and strips non-rendering metadata chunks (pHYs, tEXt, tIME) while preserving 9-patch structures and pixel accuracy.

patches.name: Playback Speed Persistence
patches.description: Persists selected video playback speed across all feed videos and application restarts.

patches.name: Popups & Prompts Suppressor
patches.description: Suppresses intrusive popups, dialogs, and modal prompts, including 'Follow your friends' dialogs, contacts sync overlays, multi-account notification guides, 2SV security checkup modals, PopLayer promotional sheets, live stream teaser bubbles, sticker recommendations, and DM streak expiration warnings.

options.title: Suppress Account & Permission Nags
options.description: Suppresses 'Follow your friends' modals, 'Find contacts' Friends tab sync overlays, multi-account notification guides, and 'Security checkup 2SV' upsells.

options.title: Suppress Sticker Recommendations
options.description: Disables personalized sticker suggestion popups and typing recommendations in direct messages.

options.title: Filter PopLayer Prompts & Nags
options.description: Suppresses repetitive PopLayer prompts including favorites collection guides, launcher shortcut dialogs, repost newbie sheets, STEM feed prompts, campus education sheets, creator inbox guides, app review dialogs, marketing opt-ins, FYP surveys, CapCut/Lemon8 upsells, profile visitor prompts, and story intro sheets.

options.title: Suppress Live Teaser Bubbles
options.description: Disables floating live stream preview teasers and popup windows from appearing over the video feed.

options.title: Suppress DM Streak Reminders
options.description: Suppresses direct message streak expiration warning banners and inline urgency reminders.

patches.name: Resource & Battery Governor
patches.description: Throttles background sensor polling (gyroscope/accelerometer 3D ads) and prevents aggressive video buffer preloading to conserve battery and CPU resources.

patches.name: Resource Slimmer
patches.description: Strips embedded third-party license text, onboarding tutorial Lottie animations, promotional GIFs, and APK root metadata/junk files.

patches.name: Resource Slimmer
patches.description: Strips embedded onboarding MP4 tutorial video, heavy IMG.LY photo editor stickers/textures, and compiler junk metadata.

patches.name: Resume Video After Scroll
patches.description: Remembers playback timestamp when scrolling away and resumes from where playback stopped upon returning.

patches.name: SIM Region Selector
patches.description: Spoofs the detected SIM and network country ISO code to bypass regional feed restrictions and catalog blocks.

options.title: Spoofed Region ISO Code
options.description: Two-letter ISO country code for SIM and network country spoofing (e.g. 'CH', 'US', 'JP', 'GB').

patches.name: Sensor Privacy Guard
patches.description: Neutralizes motion, ambient, and orientation sensor providers to prevent hardware fingerprinting and tracking via Generic Sensor APIs.

patches.name: Show Seekbar
patches.description: Restores TikTok's native video seekbar and scrubbing controls where normally hidden or disabled.

options.title: Show Dragging Thumbnail Preview
options.description: Displays real-time video frame thumbnail previews while dragging the seekbar thumb.

patches.name: Skip First Run
patches.description: Skips the welcome screen, search engine selection, and onboarding First Run Experience (FRE) on clean installs.

patches.name: Skip First-Launch Onboarding
patches.description: Bypasses the entire first-run introduction funnel (interest pickers, swipe tutorials, language prompts, and consent sheets) directly to the feed.

patches.name: Sound Features Unlock
patches.description: Unblocks Spatial Audio, hearing enhancement, and voice wake-up restrictions, unbans Spatial Audio on 96kHz aptX Adaptive connections, and bypasses XPAN requirements.

patches.name: Stop Video Looping
patches.description: Stops videos at the end instead of replaying them in an infinite loop.

patches.name: Strip Permissions
patches.description: Selectively revokes sensitive hardware, privacy, and system permissions from AndroidManifest.xml.

options.title: Strip Contacts Permission
options.description: Revokes READ_CONTACTS permission from AndroidManifest.xml (disables contact name suggestions).

options.title: Strip Microphone Permission
options.description: Revokes RECORD_AUDIO permission from AndroidManifest.xml (disables voice dictation).

options.title: Strip Media & Storage Permissions
options.description: Revokes photo and media permissions (READ_MEDIA_IMAGES, READ_MEDIA_VISUAL_USER_SELECTED, READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE) from AndroidManifest.xml (disables custom image background themes).

options.title: Strip System Dictionary Permissions
options.description: Revokes system personal dictionary sync permissions (READ_USER_DICTIONARY, WRITE_USER_DICTIONARY) from AndroidManifest.xml.

options.title: Strip Cross-Profile Permission
options.description: Revokes INTERACT_ACROSS_PROFILES permission from AndroidManifest.xml to isolate work and personal profiles.

patches.name: Studio & Creation De-bloat
patches.description: Strips heavy video creation plugins, CapCut NLE editor SDKs, effect plugins, and AR camera face models to significantly reduce APK size.

patches.name: Suppress In-App Promos & Surveys
patches.description: Suppresses intrusive in-app rating surveys, Play Store review prompts, and marketing promo popups (YouTube promo, ad-free callouts, and Brave Ads onboarding).

patches.name: Surgical OEM Unlock
patches.description: Bypasses Xiaomi OEM gating to enable full feature parity (voice assistant & spatial audio dialogs) on non-Xiaomi devices (Samsung, Pixel, etc.).

patches.name: System Font
patches.description: Forces TikTok to use the Android system font instead of bundled proprietary TikTokSans fonts.

patches.name: Unified Telemetry & Tracker Silencer
patches.description: Neutralizes ByteDance AppLog user tracking, APM/Npth/Heimdallr crash monitors, AppsFlyer attribution, and Firebase analytics.

patches.name: Universal Native Binary Trimmer
patches.description: Strips non-essential tracking, crash reporting, and debug companion native libraries in lib/** (e.g. libcrashlytics, libsentry, libbugly, libgwp-asan) by zeroing bytes in-situ.

options.title: Trim Crash Reporting Libraries
options.description: Zero native crash reporting and tracking libraries (Crashlytics, Sentry, Bugly, PLCrashReporter).

options.title: Trim Debug & Profiling Libraries
options.description: Zero debug memory and profiling libraries (GWP-ASan, Simpleperf, Android Studio profilers).

patches.name: Universal Offline Mode
patches.description: Forces offline execution across any application by revoking INTERNET and network permissions from AndroidManifest.xml and blocking cleartext HTTP traffic at the OS level.

options.title: Strip Network State Permissions
options.description: Also remove ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE and ACCESS_WIFI_STATE permissions. Default is false to prevent SecurityException crashes in apps that query network status without error handling.

options.title: Strip Wi-Fi Control Permissions
options.description: Remove CHANGE_NETWORK_STATE, CHANGE_WIFI_STATE, CHANGE_WIFI_MULTICAST_STATE, and NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES permissions.

options.title: Strip Push Notification Permissions
options.description: Remove Google Cloud Messaging and Firebase Cloud Messaging push receiver permissions (com.google.android.c2dm.permission.RECEIVE).

options.title: Strip Google Services Sync Permissions
options.description: Remove Google Services Framework and account sync permissions (com.google.android.providers.gsf.permission.READ_GSERVICES, android.permission.GET_ACCOUNTS).

options.title: Block Cleartext Traffic
options.description: Enforce android:usesCleartextTraffic='false' on the application tag in AndroidManifest.xml.

patches.name: Universal Privacy Permissions Stripper
patches.description: Selectively strips sensitive privacy, sensor, and hardware permissions from AndroidManifest.xml via configurable boolean toggles.

options.title: Strip Notification Permission
options.description: Remove POST_NOTIFICATIONS permission (Android 13+) from AndroidManifest.xml.

options.title: Strip Camera Permission
options.description: Remove CAMERA permission from AndroidManifest.xml.

options.title: Strip Microphone Permissions
options.description: Remove RECORD_AUDIO and audio capture permissions from AndroidManifest.xml.

options.title: Strip Storage & Media Permissions
options.description: Remove external storage (READ/WRITE/MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE) and media permissions (READ_MEDIA_IMAGES, READ_MEDIA_VIDEO, READ_MEDIA_AUDIO, ACCESS_MEDIA_LOCATION) from AndroidManifest.xml.

options.title: Strip Location Permissions
options.description: Remove ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION, and ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION permissions from AndroidManifest.xml.

options.title: Strip Contacts & Accounts Permissions
options.description: Remove READ_CONTACTS, WRITE_CONTACTS, and GET_ACCOUNTS permissions from AndroidManifest.xml.

options.title: Strip Calendar Permissions
options.description: Remove READ_CALENDAR and WRITE_CALENDAR permissions from AndroidManifest.xml.

options.title: Strip Nearby Devices Permissions
options.description: Remove Bluetooth scanning/connection and nearby Wi-Fi permissions (BLUETOOTH_SCAN, BLUETOOTH_CONNECT, BLUETOOTH_ADVERTISE, NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES, UWB_RANGING) from AndroidManifest.xml.

options.title: Strip Body Sensors Permissions
options.description: Remove BODY_SENSORS, BODY_SENSORS_BACKGROUND, and ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION permissions from AndroidManifest.xml.

patches.name: Universal Screen Brightness Governor
patches.description: Prevents applications from overriding display brightness (such as in-app brightness sliders, barcode/QR full-screen brightness, or window-level overrides) by neutralizing all direct writes to WindowManager.LayoutParams.screenBrightness.

patches.name: Universal Screen Timeout Enforcer
patches.description: Forces the target application to respect system screen timeout and sleep timers by neutralizing keepScreenOn view calls and stripping FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON from windows and layout parameters.

patches.name: Universal Screenshot Protection Bypass
patches.description: Neutralizes FLAG_SECURE on windows, layout params, and SurfaceViews, unlocks audio playback capture, and suppresses Android 14+ screenshot and screen recording detection callbacks.

patches.name: Universal Telemetry Neutralizer
patches.description: Strips advertising and Privacy Sandbox permissions, disables analytics ContentProviders and telemetry background services (Firebase, Sentry, Adjust, AppsFlyer, DataTransport), prunes ComponentDiscovery registrars, and injects telemetry opt-out metadata.

options.title: Revoke Advertising & Tracking Permissions
options.description: Remove AD_ID, Privacy Sandbox attribution/topics/audiences, and Play Install Referrer permissions from AndroidManifest.xml.

options.title: Disable Telemetry ContentProviders
options.description: Disable analytics ContentProviders (Google Measurement, Sentry, Facebook, Flurry, Branch, AppsFlyer).

options.title: Disable Telemetry Background Services
options.description: Disable Google Measurement, Google DataTransport, Firebase Sessions, and AppsFlyer background job services.

options.title: Disable Telemetry Receivers
options.description: Disable install referrer and analytics measurement broadcast receivers (Adjust, AppsFlyer, Google Measurement).

options.title: Inject Telemetry Opt-Out Flags & Prune Registrars
options.description: Inject meta-data opt-out entries into application tag (Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Performance, AppsFlyer, Sentry) and prune Firebase discovery registrars.

options.title: Disable Firebase Init Provider
options.description: Disable com.google.firebase.provider.FirebaseInitProvider. Default is false to prevent issues in apps that depend on Firebase Auth or push notifications.

patches.name: Universal WebP Asset Optimizer
patches.description: Losslessly strips non-rendering metadata and ancillary chunks (EXIF, XMP, ICCP) from WebP assets across res/ and assets/ to reduce APK size.

options.title: Strip EXIF Metadata
options.description: Remove camera parameters, geolocation, and creator metadata chunks from WebP images.

options.title: Strip XMP Metadata
options.description: Remove Adobe XMP XML metadata chunks from WebP images.

options.title: Strip ICC Color Profiles
options.description: Remove ICCP color profile chunks. Default is false to preserve color profile fidelity on wide-gamut displays.

patches.name: Unlock Pro
patches.description: Unlocks local Hevy Pro capabilities (unlimited workout routines, routine folders, advanced graphs, and local analytics) by dynamically enabling Pro getters and suppressing grace period payment warnings in Hermes Bytecode (HBC96).

patches.name: Update Prompt Suppressor
patches.description: Neutralizes background update polling tasks and device ID check routines to prevent forced update popups.

patches.name: Video Quality Governor
patches.description: Caps video playback and download resolutions (1080p, 720p, 540p, 480p, 360p) independently to conserve battery, GPU/MediaCodec load, and mobile data.

options.title: Maximum Playback Resolution
options.description: Select maximum video playback resolution ceiling: 1080 (1080p ExtremelyHigh), 720 (720p SuperHigh), 540 (540p H_High), 480 (480p High), or 360 (360p Standard).

options.title: Maximum Download Resolution
options.description: Select maximum video download resolution ceiling: 1080 (1080p Maximum Quality), 720 (720p SuperHigh), 540 (540p H_High), 480 (480p High), or 360 (360p Standard).
